files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define the Trace graph records with no local imports. Incident(name:str, description, start_time, region:str=""); Person(name:str, age:int=0, notes, external_id:str="") with no status field; Claim(claim_type:str, value, timestamp, notes:str="", seen_by_watch:bool=False, incident_id, ingested_at, original_content, source_reference, extraction_method, ingestion_key, payload_hash, external_id:str=""); Organization; Source(name:str, source_type, url, external_id:str=""); Media; Location; VerificationSignal; Subscription(subscriber_name:str, subscriber_contact, external_id:str=""); Alert(message:str, created_at:str="", severity:str="info", claim_id:str=""); obj IdentityReviewEntry; IdentityDecision; IdentityProposal; ActivityEntry(walker_name:str, message:str, created_at:str="", incident_id:str="", target_ids:list[str]=[]); InvestigationRun(person_id:str, fingerprint:str, result_json:str, created_at:str="", mode:str=""); MediaMetadata, MediaComment, MediaAssertion. Ids come from jid(), not stored fields; timestamps are ISO strings.

signatures.Incident: node Incident { has name: str, description: str = "", start_time: str = "", region: str = ""; }
signatures.Person: node Person { has name: str, age: int = 0, notes: str = "", external_id: str = ""; }
signatures.Claim: node Claim { has claim_type: str, value: str = "", timestamp: str = "", notes: str = "", seen_by_watch: bool = False, incident_id: str = "", ingested_at: str = "", original_content: str = "", source_reference: str = "", extraction_method: str = "", ingestion_key: str = "", payload_hash: str = "", external_id: str = ""; }
signatures.Source: node Source { has name: str, source_type: str = "", url: str = "", external_id: str = ""; }
signatures.Subscription: node Subscription { has subscriber_name: str, subscriber_contact: str = "", external_id: str = ""; }
signatures.Alert: node Alert { has message: str, created_at: str = "", severity: str = "info", claim_id: str = ""; }
signatures.ActivityEntry: node ActivityEntry { has walker_name: str, message: str, created_at: str = "", incident_id: str = "", target_ids: list[str] = []; }
signatures.InvestigationRun: node InvestigationRun { has person_id: str, fingerprint: str, result_json: str, created_at: str = "", mode: str = ""; }

files.purpose: Import the node types from graph/nodes.jac and declare typed edges: Involves Incident->Person, Contains Incident->Media, Asserts Source->Claim, About Claim->Person, SupportedBy Claim->Media, Depicts Media->Person, LocatedAt Media->Location, HasSignal Media->VerificationSignal, HasSubscription Person->Subscription, Receives Subscription->Alert, HasOrganization Incident->Organization, Publishes Organization->Source, HasInvestigation Incident->InvestigationRun, Triggered Claim->Alert (walker_name:str="WatchWalker", created_at:str=""), Reviews IdentityDecision->Person, ExactCopyOf Media->Media (hash_algo:str="sha256", detected_by, detected_at), ReportedAt Claim->Location, HasSource Incident->Source.

Import ActivityEntry from graph/nodes.jac. now_iso returns the current UTC time as an ISO string with seconds precision. glob PLAIN_STATUS maps MISSING, FOUND_SAFE, INJURED, DECEASED, SEEN_AT_LOCATION to plain phrases ("reported missing", "reported safe", ...); plain_status falls back to the lowercased code with underscores replaced by spaces. log_activity connects a new ActivityEntry(walker_name, message, created_at=now_iso(), incident_id) to root.

signatures.log_activity: def log_activity(walker_name: str, message: str, incident_id: str = "") -> None

files.purpose: Import Incident, Person, Claim, Alert, InvestigationRun from graph/nodes.jac and Involves, About, Asserts, HasSubscription, Receives, HasInvestigation from graph/edges.jac. obj TimelineEntry carries id, kind (claim/alert/investigation), person_id, claim_id, source_name (sources joined by "; "), source_ids, claim_type, reported_at, ingested_at, source_reference, recorded_at, text, status, mode, subscriber_names, status_changed, previous_claim_id, previous_claim_type, total_entries. person_timeline finds the Incident on root by jid and the Person it Involves; gathers claims About the person (skipping claims whose incident_id names another incident) sorted by parsed reported time then ingested time, source and kind rank, marking status_changed/previous_claim_* against the prior claim; adds alerts received through the person's HasSubscription->Receives edges (deduped, citing claim_id when it is one of the person's claims, collecting subscriber names); adds InvestigationRuns on the incident for this person, reading status, mode, run_at, message and the first citation's claim_id from result_json. Sorts all rows, keeps the latest 50 and sets total_entries on each. Unknown incident or person returns [].

signatures.TimelineEntry: obj TimelineEntry { has id: str, kind: str, person_id: str, claim_id: str = "", source_name: str = "", source_ids: list[str] = [], claim_type: str = "", reported_at: str = "", ingested_at: str = "", source_reference: str = "", recorded_at: str = "", text: str = "", status: str = "", mode: str = "", subscriber_names: list[str] = [], status_changed: bool = False, previous_claim_id: str = "", previous_claim_type: str = "", total_entries: int = 0; }
signatures.person_timeline: def:pub person_timeline(incident_id: str, person_id: str) -> list[TimelineEntry]

files.purpose: Entry point that registers the timeline endpoint and re-exports the activity helpers: import TimelineEntry, person_timeline from services/timeline.jac and now_iso, plain_status, log_activity from graph/activity.jac. No other code.

verify.flow: seed incident/person/source/claims on root -> person_timeline -> alerts and runs -> activity log
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and Jac behavior tests for timeline ordering, linked alerts and runs, incident scoping, plain status and activity logging.

assumption: Backend slice from the Trace hackathon app (pathakanshu/trace). graph/nodes.jac, graph/edges.jac, graph/activity.jac and services/timeline.jac are verbatim; the source main.jac is a fullstack entry with JSX and failing imports, so a thin service main.jac re-exports the slice.
